{{Quote|You have come, at last. We have waited, the Force as our guide, awaiting your arrival.|Krizta, to the Heroes of Cularin|<ref name="Counterstrike (Living Force)">{{LivingForce|For Every Action: Counterstrike}}</ref>}}
'''Krizta''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Tarasin]] [[Force Adept]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], while she was still a child, Krizta, her brother [[Trik]], and a number of other Tarasin were kidnapped by the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Haast Aath]] and taken to a slave compound on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tharados]]. From there, Krizta and Trik were transported to the planet [[Kemix]], where they were imprisoned aboard the [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] ''[[Rightful Dominion]]''. The Tarasin elder [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Tysara]] hired the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents, to return Krizta and Trik to Cularin, and the agents subsequently tracked down and rescued the two Tarasin.
